_about: Settings for the globe page. To add a baseline: build it with tools/sheet_to_globe, then add one entry to layers. To change where the page opens or flies to, edit focus and start. Baselines download only when zoomed in past load_from_zoom, and only the years in use; max_loaded caps how many stay in memory. Add show: false to a layer to keep it listed but off the page.
title: Tegucigalpa
intro: The valley as the surveyors drew it, laid back onto the globe. Slide through the years to watch the city grow, or switch to the satellite view.
